title: Agent facts
description: What the agent knows about its machine, sent inside the hello message. The router stores the object as it is (registry) and derives the node from it: name fallback, GPU, VRAM, MAC for Wake-on-LAN, the binary for agent updates, and which optional features the agent supports. No field is required by the router; without os, arch and agent_version the router cannot offer agent updates. Receivers ignore unknown fields.

hostname.description: Host name of the machine. Used as the node name when hello.node is empty, and as the Home Assistant device name.

os.description: Operating system in Go's GOOS spelling (windows, linux, darwin). Selects the agent and Ollama update archive.

arch.description: CPU architecture in Go's GOARCH spelling (amd64, arm64). Selects the agent and Ollama update archive.

manufacturer.description: System manufacturer, shown in the UI and Home Assistant. Absent when unknown.

model.description: System model, shown in the UI and Home Assistant. Absent when unknown.

gpu_present.description: Whether the agent found a GPU (agent setting gpu.probe). false: the node runs without one and the router sizes its models by main memory (ADR-0102). Absent (agents before 0.36.0) counts as true; the Go agent always sends it.

gpu.description: Name of the GPU the agent measures. Absent without a GPU or when no GPU sample was available at login.

vram_total_mib.description: Total VRAM of that GPU in MiB; the router derives the node's VRAM capacity from it. Absent without a GPU or when unknown.

mac.description: MAC address of the interface that reaches the router, for Wake-on-LAN. The Go agent sends upper case. Absent when unknown.

local_ip.description: IP address of that interface, informational (UI).

ollama_version.description: Version reported by the local Ollama's /api/version at login. Absent for an OpenAI-compatible upstream or when Ollama did not answer.

ollama_url.description: Base URL of the upstream the agent forwards to, informational (UI).

agent_version.description: Version of the agent. The router compares it with the release it offers and completes an update order when it changes.

ollama_managed.description: true: Ollama runs as a child of this agent, so the router may offer Ollama updates (control message ollama-update). Only true enables them.

ollama_push.description: true: the agent reports the Ollama state itself (frame OLLAMA). Informational: the router decides by the frames it receives.

ollama_swap_gate.description: true: after downloading an Ollama update the agent reports state ready and swaps only on the router's ollama-swap message.

upstream_api.description: Kind of upstream. Absent means ollama; the Go agent sends only openai, for an OpenAI-compatible server.

upstream_release.description: true (with upstream_api openai): the agent stops and starts its OpenAI-compatible upstream on upstream-hold and upstream-release.

upstream_fallback.description: true (with upstream_release): while the upstream is held, a standby Ollama serves in its place and the OLLAMA frame says serving ollama.
